name: The Westin Riverfront Resort & Spa at Beaver Creek Mountain
insider_take: This ski-in, ski-out resort sits at 8,100 feet elevation, making it one of the highest luxury hotels in North America with direct mountain access.
whats_special: The resort features Colorado's largest ski-in, ski-out spa and connects directly to Beaver Creek's pristine slopes via the Village Express Lift. The property's unique location in Beaver Creek Village means you're steps from world-class skiing, exclusive boutiques, and the famous Birds of Prey World Cup downhill course that hosts Olympic-caliber racers.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the Spa Anjali during après-ski hours (3-5 PM) when most guests are still on the mountain - you'll have easier access to the rooftop hot tubs with unobstructed mountain views.
dont_miss: The resort's fire pit gatherings with s'mores each evening, and if visiting in summer, the Eagle Bahn Gondola ride to see wildflower meadows and hiking trails that transform this winter wonderland into an alpine paradise.
pros: Ski-in/ski-out access to Beaver Creek Mountain
Premium riverfront location with scenic views
Luxury amenities and Westin signature services
cons: Premium pricing during peak ski season
